sentences.en: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.
sentences.zh: 然而无论黑暗多么巨大，我们必须自己发光。

sentences.en: Algeria has a vast amount of biodiversity in the north.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚北部拥有多样化的生物资源。

sentences.en: He acquired a vast amount of wealth in these few years.
sentences.zh: 他在短短几年内积累了大量的财富。

senses.zh: 广阔的；巨大的；大量的；巨额的

mnemonic: 联想记忆：古老的东方（east）地大物博，人口众多（vast）
